lead.titleZh: 2027 年 Medicare 医师费用表提案：物理治疗师需知（第一部分）
lead.titleEn: 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule Proposal: What PTs Need to Know, Part 1
lead.paragraphZh: 今日共 9 条更新，其中 5 条关注行业与执业。最高分条目并列 2 条，均为 90 分，围绕 2027 年 Medicare 医师费用表提案及澳大利亚假足病医师判决。对于临床物理治疗师，Medicare 费用表提案是直接影响收入与执业的重要信息。
lead.paragraphEn: Today features 9 updates, with 5 focusing on industry and practice. Two top-scored items, both at 90 points, cover the 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule proposal and a fake Australian podiatrist's sentencing. For clinical physical therapists, the Medicare fee schedule proposal directly impacts revenue and practice.

items.title: Spine-related leg pain: Definitions, etiology, clinical presentation, and management.
items.summary: This review clarifies definitions, etiology, clinical presentation, and management of spine-related leg pain (SRLP), distinguishing between radiculopathy, radicular pain, and somatic referred pain to improve diagnostic consistency.
items.curatedReason: 脊柱相关腿痛（SRLP）的分类和诊断共识依然混乱，这篇综述能帮你梳理清楚神经根病、神经根痛和躯体牵涉痛的界限，有助于你更精准地诊断。
items.titleZh: 脊柱相关腿痛：定义、病因、临床表现与管理
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述阐明了脊柱相关腿痛（SRLP）的定义、病因、临床表现和管理，区分了神经根病、神经根痛和躯体牵涉痛，旨在提高诊断一致性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The consensus on classification and diagnosis of spine-related leg pain (SRLP) remains elusive. This review helps clarify the distinctions between radiculopathy, radicular pain, and somatic referred pain, facilitating more precise diagnoses.
items.limitation: 本综述是叙述性总结，未提供量化证据合成。
items.limitationEn: This narrative review provides a descriptive summary and does not include quantitative evidence synthesis.

items.title: Criteria for Return to Sport after Anterior Cruciate Ligament ...
items.summary: This is a protocol for a prospective observational study in France on criteria for return to sport after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction with lower reinjury risk.
items.curatedReason: 这份 2017 年的文献是关于 ACL 重建后重返运动标准的观察性研究方案。了解其研究设计有助于你理解后续研究的演变，但它本身不提供干预证据。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建术后重返运动标准与再损伤风险降低（CR’STAL研究）：法国一项前瞻性观察性研究方案
items.summaryZh: 这是一项关于前交叉韧带重建术后重返运动及降低再损伤风险标准的法国前瞻性观察性研究方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This 2017 paper describes a protocol for an observational study on return-to-sport criteria after ACL reconstruction. Understanding its study design helps you comprehend the evolution of subsequent research, but it doesn't provide intervention evidence itself.
items.limitation: 这是一项研究方案，尚未发布结果。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and results have not yet been published.

items.title: A Water Orientation Evaluation Tool for Children with Autism Spectrum Disorders: Development and Pilot on Feasibility, Reliability, and Validity | Advances in Neurodevelopmental Disorders
items.summary: This original paper describes the development and pilot of a Water Orientation Evaluation Tool for children with Autism Spectrum Disorders, assessing its feasibility, reliability, and validity.
items.curatedReason: 自闭症谱系障碍儿童的水中定向评估工具开发。水上干预对ASD儿童的运动发展有益，这个工具能帮你更系统地评估和指导水中治疗。
items.titleZh: 自闭症谱系障碍儿童水上定向评估工具：开发及可行性、可靠性和有效性初步研究
items.summaryZh: 这篇原创论文描述了为自闭症谱系障碍儿童开发水上定向评估工具的过程及其可行性、可靠性和有效性的初步研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: Development of a Water Orientation Evaluation Tool for Children with Autism Spectrum Disorders. Aquatic interventions benefit motor development in ASD children, and this tool helps you systematically assess and guide aquatic therapy.
items.limitation: 本研究为初步的工具开发和可行性验证，需要大规模研究进一步验证其信度和效度。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary tool development and feasibility study, requiring larger-scale research to further validate its reliability and validity.

items.title: Peripheral nerve stimulation for essential tremor: a GRADE-assessed systematic review and meta-analysis | Neurosurgical Review
items.summary: A GRADE-assessed systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated peripheral nerve stimulation for essential tremor.
items.curatedReason: 外周神经刺激（PNS）治疗原发性震颤的系统综述和Meta分析。这是一项高等级证据，PNS作为非侵入性神经调节方法，未来可能在运动障碍康复中扮演更重要角色。
items.titleZh: 外周神经刺激治疗原发性震颤：一项GRADE评估的系统综述和Meta分析
items.summaryZh: 一项经GRADE评估的系统综述和Meta分析对外周神经刺激治疗原发性震颤的疗效进行了评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: This GRADE-assessed systematic review and meta-analysis on peripheral nerve stimulation (PNS) for essential tremor provides high-level evidence. PNS, as a non-invasive neuromodulation method, may play a more significant role in motor disorder rehabilitation in the future.
items.limitation: 该领域可能仍缺乏大量高质量的RCT证据。
items.limitationEn: This field may still lack a large body of high-quality RCT evidence.

items.title: Application of unilateral biportal endoscopy in lumbar spinal stenosis complicated with degenerative lumbar scoliosis and evaluation of postoperative lumbar spinal stability | European Journal of Medical Research
items.summary: This research evaluated the clinical effectiveness of unilateral biportal endoscopy in treating lumbar spinal stenosis complicated with degenerative lumbar scoliosis and assessed postoperative lumbar spinal stability.
items.curatedReason: 单侧双通道内窥镜技术在腰椎管狭窄合并退行性腰椎侧弯中的应用及其术后稳定性评估。这项研究侧重于外科技术，对物理治疗师的直接临床实践指导有限。
items.titleZh: 单侧双通道内窥镜在腰椎管狭窄合并退行性腰椎侧弯中的应用及术后腰椎稳定性评估
items.summaryZh: 这项研究评估了单侧双通道内窥镜技术治疗腰椎管狭窄合并退行性腰椎侧弯的临床有效性，并评估了术后腰椎稳定性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study focuses on the application of unilateral biportal endoscopy in lumbar spinal stenosis with degenerative lumbar scoliosis and the evaluation of postoperative spinal stability. This research focuses on surgical techniques, offering limited direct clinical guidance for physical therapists.
items.limitation: 本研究侧重于外科手术技术评估，与康复干预的直接关联性较低。
items.limitationEn: This study focuses on surgical technique evaluation and has less direct relevance to rehabilitation interventions.

items.title: Proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule: What PTs Need to Know, Part 1
items.summary: The U.S. Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services estimates a 1-3% overall payment increase for physical therapy codes under the Calendar Year 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule Proposed Rule.
items.curatedReason: 美国 CMS 2027 年医保医师费用表提案对 PT 报销预估将有 1-3% 的整体增长。这意味着你的执业收入可能略有提升，值得密切关注最终政策。
items.titleZh: 2027 年 Medicare 医师费用表提案：物理治疗师需知（第一部分）
items.summaryZh: 美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）预计，根据2027日历年度医保医师费用表提案，物理治疗代码的整体支付将增加1-3%。
items.curatedReasonEn: The proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule in the U.S. estimates a 1-3% overall payment increase for PT codes. This means your practice income might see a slight boost, so closely monitor the final policy.

items.title: Fake podiatrist sentence to be served in the community
items.summary: A fake podiatrist in Australia was sentenced to community service, highlighting the importance of regulatory compliance in healthcare professions.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚一名假足病医师被判社区服刑。这提醒你必须确保你的执业资质合规，并警惕未经授权的“治疗师”对行业的声誉损害。这是执业伦理和监管的典型案例。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚假足病医师被判社区服刑
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚一名假足病医师被判社区服刑，凸显了医疗行业监管合规的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: A fake podiatrist in Australia was sentenced to community service. This is a stark reminder to ensure your practice credentials are compliant and to be vigilant against unauthorized "therapists" damaging the profession's reputation. This is a classic case of practice ethics and regulation.

items.title: ACCESS for Primary Care Providers and Referring Clinicians
items.summary: The CMS Innovation Center launched the ACCESS model, a 10-year pilot offering ongoing, technology-supported chronic care from Medicare-enrolled providers at low or no cost to patients.
items.curatedReason: 美国 CMS 创新中心推出了 ACCESS 模式，旨在通过技术支持的慢性病护理，补充初级保健和转诊服务。这将为 PT 提供新的转诊机会和远程监测手段，你应了解如何整合到你的执业中。
items.titleZh: 面向初级保健提供者和转诊临床医师的ACCESS项目
items.summaryZh: CMS创新中心推出了ACCESS模式，这是一个为期10年的试点项目，由 Medicare 注册医疗服务提供者为患者提供持续的、技术支持的慢性护理，费用低廉或免费。
items.curatedReasonEn: The U.S. CMS Innovation Center has launched the ACCESS model, aiming to supplement primary care and referral services with technology-supported chronic care. This will open new referral opportunities and remote monitoring avenues for PTs; you should understand how to integrate this into your practice.

items.title: AHP Pre-Registration Education Lead - Peterborough job with North West Anglia NHS Foundation Trust (Health Careers)
items.summary: North West Anglia NHS Foundation Trust is hiring an AHP Pre-Registration Education Lead to provide trust-wide leadership and coordination for AHP pre-registration education.
items.curatedReason: 英国 NHS 基金会信托正在招聘 AHP（包括 PT）学前教育负责人。如果你在教育或管理岗位，这表明英国对 AHP 学生的培养和实践质量的重视。
items.titleZh: 英国北西盎格利亚 NHS 基金会信托招聘 AHP 学前教育负责人
items.summaryZh: 北西盎格利亚 NHS 基金会信托正在招聘 AHP 学前教育负责人，负责在全信托范围内领导和协调 AHP 学前教育工作。
items.curatedReasonEn: A UK NHS Foundation Trust is hiring an AHP Pre-Registration Education Lead (including PTs). If you are in an educational or management role, this indicates the UK's emphasis on the training and practice quality of AHP students.
